system_prompt: You are an expert fingerprint examiner.
user_prompt:
Below are two SLAP fingerprint images.
Each SLAP image contains either four fingers from one hand or two thumbs (one from each hand), captured simultaneously on a scanner.
Compare the corresponding fingers in both images.
Do these two images belong to the same person?
(A) Yes, same person
(B) No, different people
Reply with only the letter A or B.
